class.name: GrassField3D
class.brief_description: Procedural grass blades around the camera, with wind, clumps and LOD.
class.description: Grows real blade geometry in square tiles around the current camera, out to [member radius]. Blades sit on a jittered world grid seeded by position, so the same ground always grows the same blades; neighbouring blades are grouped into clumps that share height, facing, lean and dryness. Where a [TerrainDataMap3D] is set in [member data_map], blades stand on its height and [member rules] (a [PlantSpecies]) decides where they grow (slope, wetness, water depth, distance to water); without one they grow flat at this node's height. Each blade is a quadratic Bezier strip bent in the vertex shader by the wind from [WeatherMap3D] when one is present, else by [member fallback_wind], with its length preserved. Far tiles keep fewer blades (by a fixed rank per blade, so thinning never reshuffles) and widen them to keep the coverage. Rain from the weather map darkens and smooths the blades, and bodies in [member trample_group] lay them down (see [member trample_enabled]). Tiles are ordinary MultiMeshes, so the path tracer sees every blade.

method.name: get_far_color
method.description: The field seen from a distance, linear: the colour the ground under the grass takes where the blades have thinned away ([code]grass_ground_far[/code]), and the grass layer of [member VegetationField3D.cover_grass].

method.name: add_trample
method.description: Presses the grass at [param position] within [param radius] metres, as a mover does: flat under it, bent away from it at its rim and forward along [param velocity]. [param strength] scales the bend (0 to 1). Use it for footsteps, landings or anything not in [member trample_group].

method.name: clear_trample
method.description: Stands every trampled blade back up at once.

method.name: get_blade_count
method.description: Returns the number of blades in all live tiles. With [member gpu_fill] it counts the candidates sent to the shader, including those the rules then leave empty.

method.name: get_build_time_msec
method.description: Returns the time, in milliseconds, of the last frame that built tiles.

method.name: get_ground_shader_code
method.description: Returns shader code for a terrain material: [code]grass_ground(world_pos, albedo)[/code] mixes [param albedo] towards [member ground_tint] where this field's rules let grass grow, and [code]grass_ground_cover(world_pos)[/code] returns that coverage (0 to 1). Paste it into the terrain's shader; it reads the [code]grass_ground_*[/code] global uniforms this node publishes. Also [code]grass_ground_specular(world_pos, specular)[/code]: the ground's specular under the sward (the blades hide the soil's sheen), for the ground shader's [code]SPECULAR[/code].

method.name: get_material
method.description: Returns the blade [ShaderMaterial], built on first use. Its shader parameters can be read but are set from this node's properties.

method.name: get_tile_count
method.description: Returns the number of live tiles.

method.name: get_trample_at
method.description: Returns the trample bend at [param position]: a world x/z direction whose length is the amount, from 0 (upright) to 1 (flat). Zero outside the trample field.

method.name: is_gpu_fill_available
method.description: Whether [member gpu_fill] can run: there is a [RenderingDevice] and the fill's compute shader built.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Frees every tile; they are built again around the camera on the next frames.

method.name: update_at
method.description: Builds and frees tiles around [param center] now, as the node does each frame around the camera. Useful without a camera or in tests.

members.member: Blade colour at the root.
Minimum and maximum blade height, in metres. Each clump picks a height in this range.
Segments along each blade. 4 bends smoothly; 1 (a single triangle) suits a short, dense undercoat at a quarter of the vertices.
Blade width at the root, in metres.

Path to a [VegetationField3D] whose canopy species shade the ground (see [method VegetationField3D.get_shade_at]). When [member rules] narrows [member PlantSpecies.shade_range], blades and the ground tint follow that shade: for example [code]Vector2(0, 0.4)[/code] keeps a meadow sward out from under the trees. Call [method rebuild] after the field is populated again.
Size of a clump, in metres. Blades in a clump share height, facing, lean and dryness.
How much blade colour varies: large patches and single blades drift towards yellower or bluer greens and lighter or darker values. 0 gives every blade the same colours.
Path to a [TerrainDataMap3D] giving the ground height and the maps [member rules] read.
Blades per square metre near the camera.
Tip colour of dry blades.
Fraction of blades with dry tips. A third of those are dead from the root (thatch).
Wind velocity (x, z) in metres per second, used when no [WeatherMap3D] publishes wind.

Fill each tile's blades with a compute shader instead of the CPU loop. The CPU lists the cells the tile keeps at its level and bakes [member rules] into a 0.5 m grid; the shader makes every blade from the same hashes, clumps and light and writes the records straight into the tile's [MultiMesh] ([method RenderingServer.multimesh_mark_buffer_rd_changed]), so the path tracer sees them as before. The blades match the CPU path except within a few centimetres of a rule's edge; the main-thread cost of a tile drops by about 40%. Falls back to the CPU without a [RenderingDevice].
Colour the ground takes under the grass (the shaded thatch between blades), with alpha as the strength. Read by terrain shaders through [method get_ground_shader_code].

If [code]true[/code], this field publishes its coverage and [member ground_tint] as the [code]grass_ground_*[/code] global uniforms. With several fields, enable it on the one that covers the most ground.
Largest lean of a blade at rest, in metres of tip offset per metre of height.
Distance from the camera, in metres, to which tiles are grown.
Where grass grows: the rules of a [PlantSpecies] over the maps of [member data_map]. Its spacing, footprint and meshes are ignored. Without rules, grass grows on dry land only.
Edge of a tile, in metres.
Blade colour at the tip.
If [code]true[/code], movers lay the grass down and it springs back. The field covers [member trample_size] around the camera.

Every [Node3D] in this group tramples the grass while its underside is within the blades. Its radius comes from the meta [code]trample_radius[/code], else its first [CollisionShape3D] (sphere, capsule, cylinder or box), else [member trample_radius].
Radius, in metres, of a mover with neither a [code]trample_radius[/code] meta nor a collision shape.
Half-life, in seconds, of the bend: trampled blades stand halfway back up in this time. 0 springs back at once.
Texels a side of the trample field. Higher keeps narrower trails.
Edge, in metres, of the square trample field around the camera.
How much a blade seen edge-on widens across the view (Ghost of Tsushima's view-space thickening), so the field looks full from every side. 0 turns it off.
How far blades bend for a given wind speed.
